fato_historico: 683: During the Siege of Mecca, the Kaaba catches fire and is burned down.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an inner urge to clear away what no longer serves your path. Much like a structure once touched by flames can be rebuilt stronger, consider this an opportunity to refine your focus. It is a good time to tend to your personal sanctuary, letting go of outdated plans to make room for new growth.
frase_do_dia: From the embers of the past, your brilliant new beginning rises today.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of wisdom and inner strength through challenges.
conselho: Focus on reorganizing your environment to invite calm and clarity into your space.
